result.rationale: Verifiable in AddGuestsDialog.tsx: setIsInvalidEmail(true) is set on failed validation; it is only reset in the cancel button handler (setIsInvalidEmail(false)). The addGuestsMutation onSuccess resets multiEmailValue([""]) and closes the dialog but never resets isInvalidEmail, so the warning banner persists and reappears when the dialog is reopened after a prior failed attempt (or remains visible after a subsequent successful fix within the same session).

adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on validation failure in `handleAdd`, but it is never reset in the mutation `onSuccess` handler (only `setIsOpenDialog(false)` and `setMultiEmailValue([""])` are called). Since the dialog component is always mounted (rendered in `BookingListItem`), reopening it after a successful submit can still show the error banner because `isInvalidEmail` remains `true` unless the user hit Cancel (which does reset it).
